KeyPassages: Deuteronomy 12:15; Isaiah 35:6; Song of Solomon 2:9; Song of Solomon 2:17
BiblicalUsage: The stag is the picture of swiftness and sure-footedness. Israel might eat the hart as freely as the roebuck, Isaiah promises the lame man shall leap as a hart when the desert blooms, and the Song pictures the beloved leaping on the mountains like a young hart, coming swiftly over the hills.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God delights in giving his people a hart's feet — not just strength to stand, but joy to leap. The lame leaping is his promise, and I hold him to it.
